decisions.reason: The source changes a label in the How It Works section, not the independently defined hero copy.
The source changes landing-page How It Works copy and does not change any FAQ content.
The source's book-cover impact is already fully represented by the existing same-message MODIFY setting display_fit to show the cover in full.
Neither refitting the cover nor changing the How It Works label modifies the hero layout state.
The wording change does not alter automatic prize transfer, winner announcements, or notifications.
Changing a landing-page label to mention commission does not alter no-code reward recipients, amounts, or ticket awards.
The source does not change winner eligibility, ticket weighting, randomness, or draw execution.
The How It Works label change does not modify dashboard commission or ticket accounting behavior.
Refitting the landing-page cover and changing marketing copy do not affect the ebook reader or download experience.
The word commission in the revised label is descriptive and does not change the established mint revenue split.
The landing-page presentation tweaks do not change the deferred Transak fiat-on-ramp behavior or scope.
The source does not change certificate actions, email contents, or confirmation-email availability.
